# Busari Oluwashola Portfolio

> Busari Oluwashola is a software developer based in Ogun State, Nigeria. He builds responsive websites, web applications, digital experiences, and data-informed solutions.

## Services

- Web development: responsive websites and web applications, frontend development, backend integration, and performance tuning.
- Graphics design: brand identity, social media visuals, marketing materials, and design systems.
- Digital marketing: content strategy, audience research, campaign reporting, and conversion analysis.

## Selected work

- Responsive Portfolio Website — a personal portfolio designed for clear navigation, responsive presentation, and accessible contact paths.
- E-commerce Web App — product discovery, cart flows, and checkout UX.
- Task Management System — prioritisation, progress tracking, and daily-work planning.
- Business Landing Page — conversion-focused content hierarchy and calls to action.
- Data Visualization Dashboard — clear analytics, trends, and decision-support views.
- Blog Content Platform — content creation, publishing workflow, and readable articles.
